about.metaDescription: Guo Yi — 7+ years of full-stack engineering expertise, specializing in content platforms, dynamic RBAC systems, full-text search, and creative Canvas engineering.
about.title: Engineering ethos, craft, and what I build
about.p1: I am Guo Yi, a full-stack engineer with 7 years of production experience. Most of my career has been dedicated to engineering domain-rich, content-driven systems — enterprise CMS, multi-tenant RBAC engines, full-text search, and recommendation pipelines. Here, the frontend demands effortless interaction and accessibility, the backend must guarantee high throughput and strict consistency, and data models cannot afford sloppy compromises on day one.
about.p2: In technical choices, I practice pragmatic discipline: Next.js for cohesive end-to-end product experiences, Hono for ultra-fast, independently scalable API microservices, and Prisma with PostgreSQL for ironclad data contracts. Redis caching and BullMQ job queues are introduced precisely where performance demands them — resisting premature abstractions that solve non-existent problems.
about.p3: Outside day-to-day work, I write deep-dive technical articles dissecting real architectural trade-offs, curate an everyday toolkit, and experiment with creative coding across Canvas and SVG. The Observatory you are exploring — blending celestial charts with a living campfire simulation — is a tangible reflection of that craft.

contact.metaDescription: Guo Yi's contact channels: Email, GitHub, and social handles. Open for remote full-time positions and end-to-end full-stack consulting & contracting.
contact.title: Contact & Collaboration
contact.lede: Email is the fastest way to get in touch — I typically reply within 24 hours. You can also connect with me across GitHub, X, or WeChat.
contact.note: I excel at delivering end-to-end, high-craft small-to-mid web solutions: bespoke brand portals, custom operational dashboards, systems requiring complex RBAC permissions & third-party auth, and highly engaging interactive frontends. Flexible engagement models include fixed-scope project milestones or weekly retainers. If you have wireframes, specs, or Figma files ready, feel free to share them for an immediate scoping discussion.
